query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_consents (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  client_id INT NOT NULL,
  tenant_id INT NOT NULL,
  consent_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lgpd_contact_sharing',
  terms_version VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.0',
  consented_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  ip_address VARCHAR(45),
  user_agent VARCHAR(500),
  INDEX idx_client_consents_client (client_id),
  INDEX idx_client_consents_tenant (tenant_id),
  UNIQUE KEY unique_client_tenant_consent (client_id, tenant_id, consent_type)
);
